name: CHIKATILO V SOVJONKE
source: Dear to the heart of every Russian Andrei Romanovich mysteriously ends up in the Sovenok pioneer camp after his death. But his adventures there twist into an increasingly bloody spiral, slowly leading the protagonist to true madness...
translation: 每个俄罗斯人都心爱的安德烈·罗曼诺维奇死后神秘地进入了索维诺克先锋营。但他在那里的冒险却陷入了越来越血腥的漩涡，慢慢地将主角引向真正的疯狂……
